name: zerobounce
description: ZeroBounce email validation API v2 (default, US or EU host): validate one address (credits), batches of up to 100 (agent opt-in), credits and usage; bulk file upload, status, results and delete are node only

nodes.title: Validate email
nodes.description: Validate one address: status (valid, invalid, catch-all, unknown, spamtrap, abuse, do_not_mail), sub_status, did_you_mean, domain age, MX (1 credit; unknown results are free)

ip_address.description: IP the address signed up from (optional)

validation_timeout.description: Seconds ZeroBounce may spend (3-60, default 30); past it the result is unknown

activity_data.description: Append activity data (last seen active, in days)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Validate batch
nodes.description: Validate up to 100 addresses in one call (can take up to 70 s; 1 credit each, unknown results free) (as an agent tool only when ZEROBOUNCE_TOOL_ALLOW_BATCH=1)

activity_data.description: Append activity data (last seen active, in days)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: API usage
nodes.description: API calls and result counts by status and sub_status between two dates (free)

outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Send file
nodes.description: Upload a CSV or TXT file for bulk validation (1 credit per address; return_url gets a POST when done)

file.description: CSV or TXT file (an https URL, or an absolute path inside the plugin's upload directory)

remove_duplicate.description: Remove duplicate addresses (default true; more than 50% duplicates is a 400)

allow_phase_2.description: Run Verify+ catch-all validation (phase 2) after the first pass

return_url.description: URL ZeroBounce POSTs {file_id, file_name, upload_date} to when done

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
